damage_resolution_order: Read the weapon damage ID for the selected player mode.
Apply compatible installed-item StaticAttributeReplace rules for that same mode.
Read Damage and ArmorDamage from damage_profiles_by_id.
If ammo is selected, multiply Damage by ammo.DamageRate and ArmorDamage by ammo.ArmorDamageRate independently.
Apply the verified client rounding behavior after its half-tie behavior is confirmed.
damage.warning: Pros/Cons text and DisplayAttrValues damage labels are descriptive UI data and must not be added to DamagePointValue numerically.

extra_field.curve_input: modified stability score - baseline stability score

resolution.GSMovement_CameraScale: WeaponAppearanceTable via native weapon-description resolution; shown as current/base ratio

handling_speed.resolution: Base source rows are included, but final part-modified values use native CalcAttributeValue/CalcAttributeDetailValue.

hip_fire_accuracy.display: WaistSpreadSize and WaistSpreadDeltaMax use 2 decimals and degree labels.
hip_fire_accuracy.resolution: Final values use UWeaponDisplayUtil.CalcAttributeValue; raw WeaponSpreadTable records are included as supporting data.

main_attribute_scores.by_mode: Per player mode, the weapon's own PartsDataTable function set (FunctionId_SOL / FunctionId_Breakthrough) applies StaticAttributeReplace rules to the base score. operations uses FunctionId_SOL, warfare uses FunctionId_Breakthrough. Applied rules are listed in applied_rules; top-level display/base remain the unmodified row values.
main_attribute_scores.example: K437 (18010000040) warfare rules replace Handling (index 5) with 55 and EffectiveRange display (index 2) with 25.

recoil_control.display: 2 decimal places; the four recoil values are shown as current/base ratios.

resolution.other_fields: UWeaponDisplayUtil.CalcAttributeValue; native runtime required after parts
